answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the mesa queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 993 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the signal. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 349 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
